about: PARTICLES layers in Godot (r179, docs/effect-layers.md phase 2). Not a pixel comparison: each engine draws its own particle system. engines/godot/tests/particles.gd scrolls each scene at 60 units/s, stepped at 1/60 s, and checks at 0, 6 and 12 s that the layer's Godot scene is instanced, between the layers before and after it, where its layer has scrolled it; it saves a still of each. Pages and scenes from core/test-data/particles (libGDX's round there).

scenes.name: view-anchored-gpu
scenes.about: snow-wide.tscn (a GPUParticles2D) anchored to the VIEW: one instance, carried by the layer's scroll, its emitter kept at the view's top-left

scenes.name: layer-anchored-cpu-repeat-X
scenes.about: snow.tscn (a CPUParticles2D) pinned to the LAYER: an instance at the bottom-left corner of every tile, tiles 30 units apart

scenes.name: layer-anchored-repeat-XY
scenes.about: q02 repeating on X and Y too, scrolling up at 30 units/s: tiles on both axes

scenes.name: cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: p01 cross-fading into p02 while tinting orange (as libGDX's p03): both pages' particle nodes in their slots, each at its page's opacity; after it, only p02's

scenes.name: no-godot-scene
scenes.about: e06's PARTICLES layer names no Godot scene: nothing instanced, one warning
